rules.name: context-pack-before-task
rules.law: Give an agent a pre-computed context pack (repo tree, key file summaries, conventions) BEFORE it starts exploring; exploration turns are the expensive part (from Graft).

rules.name: persona-as-system-prompt
rules.law: Specialist roles are versioned markdown personas (frontmatter name/description + identity/mission) injected as system prompts over llm-bridge — proven live in r169 with marketing-aeo-foundations. Personas live in sovereign/knowledge/vendor/agency-agents/personas/ (MIT, attributed).

rules.name: structural-index-over-exploration
rules.law: When a codebase outgrows direct exploration, answer structural questions from a persistent index/graph, not by reading file-by-file (from codebase-memory-mcp; blocked at our current scale).

rules.name: stage-decomposed-media-pipeline
rules.law: Media production decomposes into stages (brief->assets->compose->review->render) with a schema per hand-off (from OpenMontage shape); we execute stages with sovereign skills, not local GPU pipelines.

rules.name: worktree-fanout
rules.law: Parallel bounded agent tasks each get their own git worktree of the repo — no cross-task file interference — with one central tracker (from Orca; enables r166 fleet-tasks-route at scale).

activationRoutes.how: persona body -> llm-bridge system prompt; tested r169
sovereign repo-context pack for mini-swe-agent tasks when volume rises
git worktree per parallel agent task when >1 recurring task needed

activationRoutes.blocked: repos too small to justify a 710M-index engine
AGPL + no GPU + sovereign video skill already covers us

whyNotRevenue: One direct revenue lever adopted: billable AEO/GEO/content personas for weblift and content-factory. AT-1/3/5 are cost-reduction infrastructure for agent tasks; AT-4 is a checklist.
